description: Shareholder targeting for a stock: the 13F filers of the newest closed quarter that hold its holder-overlap peers (operating companies whose active holders overlap most, funds excluded) but hold no class of the stock itself, ranked by the money they have in those peers. A stock with no overlap peers falls back to its sector's largest operating-company 13F holdings; a fund has no targets. Each target shows its 13F book, the peers' share of it, the peers it holds most of, its measured style and its holder type from regulatory records.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of targets to return (default 25, clamped to 1-500)

sort.description: Rank by: 'peerValue' (default, dollars held in the peers) or 'peerWeight' (the peers' share of the filer's 13F book, then book size)

name: GetHolderTargets
title: Shareholder Targets
